content:
Phosphor is an open-source firmware for the Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.49 wide display (640×172) devkit that turns it into a retro desk gadget. The firmware implements a clock with alarm, weather, internet radio, timers, touchable pixel scenes, three games, and small tools in four different styles, namely VFD, C64, Amiga, and Atari 2600. Phophor firmware highlights Written in Arduino C++; the radio on one of the ESP32-S3 cores, and the UI on the other core Clock and alarm Internet radio with genre buttons, dancing couple, and equalizer; supports Radio Browser, MP3 and AAC streams Three games – Blackjack, Lighthouse Keeper, and Runner Other screens – Fish tank, Lighthouse, Ocean liner, focus timer, snowy cabin, hourglass, coin flip, etc… Settings Theme – select between VFD, C64 (16 colors), Amiga (32 out of 4096 colors), and Amiga 2600 (4 colors by line) styles Time/date, units, language, brightness QR code for other settings (e.g., WiFi [...]
